goal.outcome: Trace/graph views expose decision coverage and roadmap reconciliation states for implemented, deferred, superseded, unmapped, and replanned work.
acceptance: Planning build/trace readers preserve `decision_coverage` and `roadmap_reconciliation` evidence.

Graph/lens distinguishes implemented, deferred, superseded, no-work, and active roadmap coverage.
Tests cover trace/read-model extraction and warning/finding output.

Do not purge legacy builds or validation reports.
Do not implement planning-gate policy checks already owned by TASK-107.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Graph distinguishes implemented, deferred, superseded, no-work, and active roadmap coverage.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Planning coverage state classifier reports `implemented`, `active-roadmap`, `deferred`, `no-work`, and `unmapped`; roadmap reconciliation preserves `replanned` and `superseded` states; graph-lenses assertions cover implemented, active-roadmap, deferred, no-work, replanned, and superseded states.
`tests/tasks/TASK-108/planning-trace-coverage.test.mjs` passes and wraps the smoke graph fixture assertions.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Planning build/trace readers preserve decision_coverage and roadmap_reconciliation evidence.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: `src/state/graph.ts` preserves planning build `decision_coverage` and `roadmap_reconciliation`; `src/state/graph/trace-projection.ts` preserves trace planning rows with exact JSON pointer refs.
